wallet.title: My Wallet
wallet.lead: View and top up your balance, and track your transaction history.

help.title: Wallet Guide
help.body: Your wallet balance can be used across the entire platform (including tuition payments). "Top up" takes you to the payment gateway, and upon successful payment, the amount is instantly added to your wallet.

topupResult.failed: Top-up failed; if any amount was deducted, it will be refunded.

error.topupAmount: Please enter a valid top-up amount (positive number, Rials).

withdraw.title: Withdraw to Bank Account
withdraw.note: The requested amount is immediately reserved from your wallet and will be deposited into your account after financial manager approval.
withdraw.ok: Withdrawal request submitted and amount reserved; it will be deposited after financial approval.

receipt.title: Wallet Receipt
receipt.footer: This receipt is generated automatically by the system.

help.title: Tuition Help
help.body: Tuition = Fixed (basis for course selection gate) + Variable (number of credits × rate per credit) − Discount/Scholarship. Until the fixed tuition is paid, course selection is locked. You can pay the total remaining balance or each installment. In test mode, the gateway is a mock gateway and is not real.

empty.noTerm: There is no active term for tuition calculation.
empty.noTariff: The tuition tariff for your program has not been set yet. Please contact the finance department.

gate.open: ✅ Fixed tuition paid — course selection is open.
gate.locked: ⚠️ Fixed tuition ({amount}) is not paid — course selection is locked.

breakdown.title: Tuition Breakdown
breakdown.variable: Variable Tuition ({credits, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}} × {rate})

guest.title: Sign in to continue
guest.body: Sign in to your account to make a purchase or change your subscription. Your selected plan will be saved after you log in.

checkout.quota: AI message limit: {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} per month
checkout.creditNote: An amount of {amount} for the unused days of your current plan will be credited to your wallet.
checkout.prorationNote: Only the prorated amount for the remaining days until the end of the current cycle has been calculated.
checkout.mockNote: «Sample» test gateway — real payment will be activated once the gateway is connected

cancel.title: Cancel Subscription
cancel.body: Your current subscription will be canceled and you will return to the free plan.

orgInvoice.title: Organization Invoices
orgInvoice.lead: Corporate training invoices: issuance, due date tracking, and settlement upon financial department approval.

help.title: What does this page do?
help.body: You issue the invoice, the organization issues the remittance, and registers a «Settlement Request» right here. The invoice is not marked as «Settled» until the finance department approves the remittance; financial approval is what writes the general ledger entry.

kpi.filteredNote: Status filter is active; only the card for that status has a number while the rest remain «—», because the filtered list is not the source for counting other statuses.

state.emptyFiltered: No invoices found matching this filter.
state.empty: No invoices have been issued yet.

print.paidNote: This invoice has been settled and its corresponding entry is recorded in the general ledger.
print.pendingNote: The settlement request for this invoice has been submitted but not yet approved by the finance department; this document is not a payment receipt.
print.dueNote: This invoice has not been settled yet; this document is not a payment receipt.

settle.requestBody: This will send invoice {number} in the amount of {amount} to the finance department review queue. No funds are transferred right now; settlement will be recorded after financial approval.
settle.confirmBody: By approving, invoice {number} in the amount of {amount} will be marked as settled and a balanced general ledger entry will be created. This action cannot be undone.
settle.rejectBody: Invoice {number} will return to due status and your reason will be recorded for the organization.
settle.reasonRequired: A reason is required to reject the request.
settle.awaitingFinance: The settlement request has been submitted and is awaiting finance department approval.

lead.withCap: Organization License Seat Management — Shows how many seats are used and available out of the total {cap} purchased seats. In the allocation list, you can assign or reclaim seats for each member.
lead.noCap: Organization License Seat Management — This organization's contract cap has not been registered yet, so the "Total" and "Available" figures are not displayed. You can see the number of allocated seats and assign or reclaim seats for any member.

orgSeats.capUnsetNote: This organization's seat cap is not registered. Until the finance department registers the contract cap, "Total seats", "Available", and "Occupancy rate" will not show any figures — we do not display fabricated numbers.
orgSeats.capFull: No available seats left — license capacity is full.
orgSeats.coursesBasis: Based on {linked} out of {total} members who have user accounts.
orgSeats.coursesNoBasis: No members have user accounts, so there is no average.

cap.title: Seat Contract Cap
cap.hint: This number is the organization's license cap and is only registered by the finance department. Leaving it blank means "no cap registered" — in that case, "Total seats", "Available", and "Occupancy rate" will not show any numbers.
cap.label: Seat cap
cap.cleared: Seat cap cleared; it is now "Unregistered".
cap.invalid: The cap must be an integer between 0 and 1000000.
cap.error: An error occurred while saving the seat cap.

orgSeats.manageDenied: Allocating and reclaiming member seats is the organization manager's responsibility. The finance role registers the contract cap and views its usage.
